intuition: For an exact withdrawal, try available banknotes from largest denomination downward.

brute_force.approach: Enumerate combinations of all five note counts until one sums to the amount.
brute_force.time: Exponential in the available note counts

optimal.approach: Greedily take as many notes as possible from each denomination, then commit only if the remainder reaches zero.

edge_cases: An impossible amount returns [-1] and leaves inventory unchanged.
A valid withdrawal consumes exactly the selected note counts.
